title: Prepare existing website ownership and factual browser privacy disclosure
question: Can web ownership be verified without enabling unapproved advertising?
hypotheses: Publisher ownership files can remain separate from ad activation.
acceptance_criteria: Existing confirmed publisher identity matches ads.txt and ownership tag.
Browser disclosure describes scoped local storage and ads-off state without changing mobile or game facts.
No ad script, paid service, invented legal claim or credential is introduced.
evidence: Owner authorized website review setup and latest completion/merge/deploy request.
